title: $4.99 Rotisserie Chicken and the Economics of Loss Leaders | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: How does Costco's $4.99 rotisserie chicken manage to defy inflation? In this episode, Jill and Mark break down the economics of loss leaders — and debate whether they're willing to serve a cheaper chicken. Plus, caller George has reached his longterm savings goal at age 37. Can he afford a lifestyle change?
